snippet.title: Aeruta - Official Launch Trailer | PC(Steam)
snippet.description:
#Aeruta is here! 💥
Dive into a fast-paced action RPG that mixes dungeon battles with cozy bakery vibes.
Fight monsters, bake bread, and make friends along the way! 🍞✨

🎮 AVAILABLE NOW ON STEAM!

To find out more, visit: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286780/Aeruta/
Website: https://aeruta.startgravity.jp/
X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/Aeruta_official

Title: Aeruta
Release Date: November 5, 2025
Platform: Steam(PC)
Price: $19.99
Developer: FromDawn Games
Distributor: GRAVITY GAME ARISE Co., Ltd.
